users.title: Users and access
users.description: Who can do what for your company. Every change is a proposal that a different person approves, and stays inside the limits your bank signed.
users.caption: Members
users.name: Name
users.readOnly: You can view members. Proposing changes needs the administrator role.

change.title: Propose an access change
change.limitsHelp: Leave both empty for a member who does not create payments. The bank's agreement sets the maximum.
change.help: You state the complete access the member should have. It replaces their current access once a different person approves. You cannot change your own access.
change.limitsInvalid: Enter both amounts in LYD, or leave both empty.
change.sent: Sent for approval. Nothing changes until a different person approves.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.help: Access ends immediately and the person is signed out everywhere. Giving access back needs an approved proposal.

inbox.title: Invitation links (sandbox inbox)
inbox.help: The sandbox sends no e-mail. Approved invitations appear here so you can pass the link to the person. A link works once and expires after 7 days.

approval.title: Access change
approval.note: Approving applies exactly this access. You cannot approve a change you proposed or a change to your own access.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.body: Your company's approval levels are the ones your bank set in the signed agreement. Proposing stricter company rules is planned and is not part of this release.
rules.viewAgreement: View the agreement and its approval levels

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.intro: {company} invited {email} to its Al Qarib sandbox workspace.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
invite.existing: You already have a sign-in for this address. Accepting adds this company to it; your password does not change.
invite.done: Invitation accepted. You can sign in now.
invite.invalidBody: The link is wrong, was already used or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invitation.
